drivingQuestion: Did the Sages concede to Shimon ben Guda's testimony?

segments.he: מַאי ״לֹא הוֹדוּ לוֹ״ דְּקָאָמַר הָתָם? כׇּל סִיעָתוֹ, אֲבָל בְּנוֹ מוֹדֵי לֵיהּ. אִיבָּעֵית אֵימָא: גּוּדָּא לְחוֹד, וְגוּדָּע לְחוֹד.
segments.en: The Gemara explains: «What» is the meaning of the sentence: «But they did not concede to» the ramifications of his testimony, «which was stated there,» in the first account? The meaning is that the rest of «his entire company,» i.e., the Sages, did not concede, «but his son did concede to him. If you wish, say» instead that «Guda» with the letter alef, as stated in the first episode, is «discrete, and Guda» with an ayin, in the second account, is «discrete,» i.e., the two incidents are not referring to the same individual.
